entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jeļena "Aļona" Ostapenko is a Latvian professional tennis player. She has been ranked by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) as high as world No. 5 in singles, which she achieved on 19 March 2018, and No. 3 in doubles, attained on 14 July 2025. She is the current No. 1 player from Latvia.
